page: Microsoft Azure L4as_v5 is a virtual machine belonging to the Lasv5 server family, utilizing AMD processors on the x86_64 architecture. Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance provides 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a resource ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

For storage-intensive operations, the instance comes equipped with 960 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput disk configurations. No graphics processing units are included in this hardware profile, and it does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high memory-to-CPU ratio and fast local solid-state storage, this server offers a resource-dense profile. It is designed for workloads that require significant memory capacity and rapid local scratch space, such as database hosting, caching layers, and data indexing tasks.
description: Microsoft Azure L4as_v5 is an x86_64 virtual machine from the Lasv5 family, powered by AMD processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage capabilities include a bundled 960 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable for demanding disk configurations. This server does not include integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With its balanced allocation of memory and fast local storage, the L4as_v5 is structured for memory-optimized and storage-centric workloads. It is well-suited for database hosting, caching systems, and analytical tasks that benefit from rapid local read and write operations without requiring parallel GPU acceleration.
